Answer: B
Reason: The CT image (Figure 3) demonstrates a well-defined, homogeneous soft-tissue density mass in the right paratracheal region that abuts the trachea without causing significant narrowing or invasion, which is characteristic of a benign bronchogenic cyst. The chest X-ray (Figure 1) shows corresponding right paratracheal widening with smooth margins, further supporting a non-aggressive etiology.
